name: Shijiazhuang Tiedao University
aliases: Railway Engineering Institute of the People's Liberation Army
supervisors: Hebei Provincial Government (co-built with the National Railway Administration and the Ministry of Education)

evidence.summary: In a 2020 interview published by China Education Online, the university said it had been co-built by SASTIND and the Hebei Provincial Government since December 2013. Its 2023 overview does not mention this and lists only its co-construction by Hebei, the National Railway Administration and the Ministry of Education, from 2015.

Founded in 1950 as the PLA Railway Corps Engineering College, the university passed to the Ministry of Railways in 1984 and to Hebei Province in 2000; since 2015 it has been co-built by Hebei, the National Railway Administration and the Ministry of Education.
